en-US.description: Play Tulip apps on machines, tablets, computers, and phones. Enable powerful, consumer-grade user experiences for your workforce across devices
en-US.longDescription:
Play Tulip apps on machines, tablets, computers, and phones. Enable powerful, consumer-grade user experiences for your workforce across devices
The Tulip Player windows application, offers an extended set of features:
A more immersive user experience:
- The Tulip Player Windows App will persist its window size, position, and full screen state across restarts. This can be helpful if you always want your Tulip Player to appear in the same position, or to always be maximized.
- The Tulip Player Windows App is a dedicated user experience. It can only be used to access Tulip Apps - not Facebook.
Better hardware access:
- The Tulip Player Windows App supports Tulip Vision
- It can open files from the local computer within your Tulip App.
- In some situations, hardware barcode scanners will work better.
- It supports a wide range of hardware devices which can be found here
Better authentication experience:
- Administrators only have to authenticate the Tulip Player Windows App once per physical computer. In contrast, the Tulip Web Player has to be authenticated separately for each operator. In some situations, shareable station links can be used to work around this limitation.
- For the the Tulip Player Windows App, credentials are securely persisted to the file system. This makes it harder for an operator to accidentally de-register their station, which would require an administrator to re-register them.
- The Tulip Player Windows App can be registered with multiple Tulip instances, making it easier to switch between a staging and production instance, for example.
- The Tulip Player Windows App and the Tulip App Editor can be used simultaneously. You must sign out of the App Editor in order to access the Tulip Web Player.
Diagnostics:
- The Tulip Player Windows App makes logs easier to access.
- The Tulip Player Windows App can collect more detailed information about the computer it’s running on.
en-US.name: Tulip Player
en-US.releaseNotes:
Player 2.12.0 Release – November 2026
We're excited to announce the release of Tulip Desktop Player version 2.12.0.
Version 2.12.0 of Desktop Player is available for download at 9:00PM ET on November 7th, 2026! If you have auto updates enabled, the Desktop Player application will update in the background and changes will take effect the next time the application is restarted. Alternatively, you can manually initiate the update process from the file menu.
Bug Fixes
- Fixed an issue where the Desktop Player could stay on a gray screen, a blank page, the maintenance page or a "no available server" message after the Tulip page crashed or failed to reload, for example during a network drop or a Tulip upgrade, until it was reloaded manually. Now, the Player shows a notice that counts down to an automatic reload, waiting longer between attempts while the problem continues.
- Fixed the Tulip Player failing to open on Linux desktops running a Wayland session, such as Ubuntu 24.04. The application would start but never display a window.
- Fixed an issue where giving the Save Image trigger a relative file path (for example "images/photo.png" instead of a full path) stopped every later file download in the Player, with no error shown, until the Player was restarted. Now, Save Image reports an error for a path that is not a full path, and later downloads are unaffected. No images were lost, because the affected downloads never started. Update any trigger that still uses a relative path.
- Fixed an issue where log timestamps in the Desktop Player developer console showed a date one month earlier than the actual date. Timestamps now show the actual date and end in "Z" to show they are in UTC. Only the developer console display was affected; the Player's log files always recorded the right time.
Improvements
- Upgraded the Desktop Player runtime, bringing the latest browser and platform security fixes.
- In the Desktop Player, added a Clear Cache option to the Developer menu. It clears the Player's stored copies of web content, so the next reload downloads them again.

zh-CN.description: 在各类设备上运行 Tulip 应用，包括机器、平板、电脑和手机，为您的员工提供跨设备的强大消费级用户体验。
zh-CN.longDescription:
在各类设备上运行 Tulip 应用，包括机器、平板、电脑和手机。为您的员工提供跨设备的强大消费级用户体验。
Tulip Player Windows 应用程序提供扩展功能集：
更沉浸式的用户体验：
- 窗口尺寸、位置和全屏状态可跨重启保持，便于始终固定显示位置或保持最大化
- 专属应用环境，仅用于访问 Tulip 应用（不支持 Facebook 等无关功能）
更完善的硬件支持：
- 支持 Tulip Vision 视觉功能
- 可在 Tulip 应用中直接打开本地计算机文件
- 硬件条码扫描器兼容性更优
- 支持广泛的硬件设备（具体清单参见此处）
更便捷的认证体验：
- 管理员只需为每台物理计算机认证一次（相比网页版需逐个操作员认证）
- 凭证安全存储于文件系统，避免操作员意外注销工作站（需管理员重新注册）
- 支持同时注册多个 Tulip 实例（如测试环境与生产环境快速切换）
- 可与 Tulip 应用编辑器同时运行（使用网页版需先退出编辑器）
诊断功能：
- 日志访问更便捷
- 可收集更详尽的运行设备信息
